svg.title: One Owner, Three Specialists; Two Seats Added at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-mineral-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: One Owner, Three Specialists; Two Seats Added at Scale; subtitle: Base pod: 1 FT + 3 C. Scaled pod: 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each stage represents one person, not one full-time equivalent. The first four seats form both Conservative and Base pods. The final two seats are Scaled-only additions. FT means full-time; C means contractor. Contractor capacity is fractional and scheduled against actual transaction workload.; caption: Four people support the $30,000 and $215,000 revenue cases; six support the $400,000 case. Expansion depends on verified workload and economics, not headcount as a revenue predictor.; stages: label: Owner and acquisition principal leads the base pod; value: Base seat one: one full-time acquisition principal; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own sourcing, underwriting decisions, cash allocation, offer authority, royalty exception review, and institutional buyer relationships. Maintain the investment register and distinguish acquisition capital from recognized operating revenue.; label: Contract landman establishes the title evidence trail; value: Base seat two: one contract land specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Build tract-level run sheets, calculate supported ownership fractions, monitor recording, and track operator transfer documents. Escalate instrument interpretation and contested title issues to counsel rather than resolving them through spreadsheet labels.; label: Contract petroleum engineer challenges production assumptions; value: Base seat three: one contract petroleum engineer; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review well-level decline, commodity sensitivities, offset evidence, downtime, and development scenarios. Keep proved cash-producing exposure separate from unfunded drilling inventory and docket-driven acquisition hypotheses.; label: Contract counsel covers mineral and tax structuring; value: Base seat four: one qualified contract attorney; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use counsel with demonstrated mineral conveyance and tax competence for instrument review, title remedies, entity structure, and depletion questions. Securities work requires matching expertise before pooled funding; if separate specialists become recurring seats, revise headcount and costs explicitly.; label: Royalty operations analyst joins only at scale; value: Scaled seat five: one additional full-time analyst; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take over statement ingestion, deposit matching, production monitoring, suspense tracking, and exception queues. Use Python csv and sqlite3 for reproducible reconciliation while preserving original operator statements and review history.; label: Disposition specialist joins only at scale; value: Scaled seat six: one additional contract specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Assemble buyer data rooms, normalize asset schedules, coordinate bids, and track closing deliverables. Document asset-sale intermediary authority and any jurisdiction-specific licensing requirements before accepting the engagement.

text.title: One Owner, Three Specialists; Two Seats Added at Scale
text.tspan: One Owner, Three Specialists; Two Seats Added at Scale

circle.title: label: Owner and acquisition principal leads the base pod; value: Base seat one: one full-time acquisition principal; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own sourcing, underwriting decisions, cash allocation, offer authority, royalty exception review, and institutional buyer relationships. Maintain the investment register and distinguish acquisition capital from recognized operating revenue.

text.title: Owner and acquisition principal leads the base pod

Own sourcing, underwriting decisions, cash allocation, offer authority, royalty exception review, and institutional buyer relationships. Maintain the investment register and distinguish acquisition capital from recognized operating revenue.

circle.title: label: Contract landman establishes the title evidence trail; value: Base seat two: one contract land specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Build tract-level run sheets, calculate supported ownership fractions, monitor recording, and track operator transfer documents. Escalate instrument interpretation and contested title issues to counsel rather than resolving them through spreadsheet labels.

text.title: Contract landman establishes the title evidence trail

Build tract-level run sheets, calculate supported ownership fractions, monitor recording, and track operator transfer documents. Escalate instrument interpretation and contested title issues to counsel rather than resolving them through spreadsheet labels.

circle.title: label: Contract petroleum engineer challenges production assumptions; value: Base seat three: one contract petroleum engineer; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review well-level decline, commodity sensitivities, offset evidence, downtime, and development scenarios. Keep proved cash-producing exposure separate from unfunded drilling inventory and docket-driven acquisition hypotheses.

text.title: Contract petroleum engineer challenges production assumptions

Review well-level decline, commodity sensitivities, offset evidence, downtime, and development scenarios. Keep proved cash-producing exposure separate from unfunded drilling inventory and docket-driven acquisition hypotheses.

circle.title: label: Contract counsel covers mineral and tax structuring; value: Base seat four: one qualified contract attorney; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use counsel with demonstrated mineral conveyance and tax competence for instrument review, title remedies, entity structure, and depletion questions. Securities work requires matching expertise before pooled funding; if separate specialists become recurring seats, revise headcount and costs explicitly.

text.title: Contract counsel covers mineral and tax structuring

Use counsel with demonstrated mineral conveyance and tax competence for instrument review, title remedies, entity structure, and depletion questions. Securities work requires matching expertise before pooled funding; if separate specialists become recurring seats, revise headcount and costs explicitly.

circle.title: label: Royalty operations analyst joins only at scale; value: Scaled seat five: one additional full-time analyst; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take over statement ingestion, deposit matching, production monitoring, suspense tracking, and exception queues. Use Python csv and sqlite3 for reproducible reconciliation while preserving original operator statements and review history.

text.title: Royalty operations analyst joins only at scale

Take over statement ingestion, deposit matching, production monitoring, suspense tracking, and exception queues. Use Python csv and sqlite3 for reproducible reconciliation while preserving original operator statements and review history.

circle.title: label: Disposition specialist joins only at scale; value: Scaled seat six: one additional contract specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Assemble buyer data rooms, normalize asset schedules, coordinate bids, and track closing deliverables. Document asset-sale intermediary authority and any jurisdiction-specific licensing requirements before accepting the engagement.
